statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
There is clinical suspicion for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
A mobile cardiac telemetry study (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was ordered to capture and characterize the underlying arrhythmia during symptomatic periods
The diagnoses are I49.9 and I47.1
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization before services were rendered
